pattern.label: Page pattern, like service in city

rows.label: CSV with one row of real data per page

last_batch.label: URLs of the batch shipped about 14 days ago, or blank on the first run

steps.title: Check search demand
steps.prompt: Pattern: {{inputs.pattern}}. Using the keyword data service, check search volume for the pattern with each modifier in {{inputs.rows}}. Write {{run.dir}}/demand.md: each modifier with its volume, and which have none.

steps.title: Design the page template
steps.prompt: Read this repository and {{run.dir}}/demand.md. Design a page template for {{inputs.pattern}} where at least half of each page comes from that row's own data. Write {{run.dir}}/template.md: sections, which column fills each, and the URL pattern. Do not edit the repository.

steps.title: Generate the pages
steps.prompt: From table rows in {{run.dir}}/data.sqlite, take the rows with demand in {{run.dir}}/demand.md whose rowid modulo 4 is {{index}}. Write one page per row following {{run.dir}}/template.md into {{run.dir}}/pages/. Use only that row's data and facts it supports.

steps.title: Reject thin pages
steps.prompt: Compare every page in {{run.dir}}/pages/ with the others. Score how much of each is unique to its row. Write {{run.dir}}/pages.json as a list of items with id, title (the URL), preview (first line), score (uniqueness 0 to 1), reason and status: dropped below 0.5, otherwise pending. Set the output key items to that path.

steps.title: Add the first batch to the site
steps.prompt: Add the first 20 pages in {{run.dir}}/pages.json with status approved (or pending if none are approved) to the site in this worktree, following {{run.dir}}/template.md, and add them to the sitemap. Commit on the current branch. Do not push. Set urls to the 20 page URLs.

steps.title: Approve the batch
steps.gate_summary: Preview: {{steps.preview.outputs.url}}. Batch: {{steps.build.outputs.urls}}. Approve to deploy these 20 pages and the sitemap to production.

steps.title: Check the last batch is indexed
steps.prompt: Read Search Console indexing status for the previous batch: {{inputs.last_batch}}. If blank, write that there is no previous batch. Write {{run.dir}}/indexing.md: each URL and its status. Set passed to false when fewer than 80% are indexed, so the next batch waits. Put this run's batch in the file too for next time: {{steps.build.outputs.urls}}.
